name: flitware
description: Fleet and maintenance operations: vehicles, services, work orders, documents, checklists and support tickets with human approval for sensitive writes.

interface.longDescription: Flitware connects ChatGPT to your fleet operation: list vehicles and their status, review overdue preventive maintenance, inspect work orders, track document expirations, submit driver checklists, and open support tickets. Reads are tenant-isolated; writes use preview-then-confirm, and sensitive changes require human approval in the Flitware web app. Flitware only accesses data available to your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Show my fleet vehicles and their status.

positive.prompt: Show my fleet vehicles and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the tenant's vehicles with plate and status. No data from other tenants.
List OVERDUE items with vehicle, due date and reason. Empty list when nothing is overdue, never invented items.
Return blocks, warnings and info gaps with evidence references and suggested actions, deterministically ordered.

positive.description: Support ticket with preview then confirm
positive.prompt: Open a support ticket about a flat tire on vehicle ESQ50E.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a field diff preview first and create the ticket only after the user confirms. Return the ticket id and verify it by reading it back.

positive.prompt: Report the maintenance costs of vehicle ESQ50E for the last 6 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a monthly cost table with currency and coverage (included vs total orders). State explicitly when data is insufficient instead of showing zero.

negative.prompt: Show me the vehicles of another company that also uses Flitware.
Delete all my vehicles and all their history.
Pay the pending invoice for supplier ACME for $100.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 60 MCP tools for fleet, services, maintenance, documents, checklists, support and scheduled analyses, with OAuth login and human approval for sensitive writes.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestiona tu flota
es-ES.description: Flitware conecta ChatGPT con tu operación de flota: consulta vehículos y su estado, revisa mantenimientos preventivos vencidos, inspecciona órdenes de trabajo, controla vencimientos documentales, envía checklists de conductor y abre tickets de soporte. Las lecturas están aisladas por empresa; las escrituras usan vista previa con confirmación, y los cambios sensibles requieren aprobación humana en la app web de Flitware. Flitware solo accede a los datos disponibles para tu cuenta conectada.
